name: Debian
description: The universal operating system, one of the oldest community Linux distributions.
summary: Debian's adopted resolution neither endorses nor prohibits generative AI tools, but contributors remain accountable for AI-assisted work and are expected to review and test it, with care for licensing. It encourages disclosure without requiring it and does not specifically address AI-written issues or summaries.

evidence.quote: The use of a generative AI tool does not diminish the contributor's responsibility for the work they submit. Contributors are expected to understand, review, test, and, where appropriate, modify AI-assisted output before incorporating it into Debian.

Project members are expected to exercise appropriate care when using generative AI tools, to consider the provenance and licensing implications of material they contribute, and to avoid introducing content whose legal status they cannot reasonably justify.
The responsibility for every contribution rests with the contributor who submits it, who remains accountable for its technical quality, legal acceptability, and suitability for inclusion in Debian.

sources.title: General Resolution: LLM usage in Debian
